scope: EVM settlement proof submission from the relayer
issue_fixed: The relayer could produce portable EVM receipt proofs but could not bind them to a runtime settlement intent, convert them to the runtime proof type, sign the runtime-monomorphized extrinsic, or submit it.
implementation: Carry the runtime settlement intent id through EVM and SVM proof requests.
Reject zero runtime intent ids before proof acquisition or network calls.
Decode the canonical EVM verification payload into the settlement engine's typed SettlementProof.
Match the decoded block header, block hash, state root, receipt root, confirmations, receipt index, trie path, and DepositLocked event fields.
Map configured X3 EVM domains to the settlement engine's chain-specific ExternalChainId.
Build the runtime signer from the configured URI and require its derived SS58 account to equal relayer_account.
Sign submit_proof with the exact runtime SignedExtra and submit it through author_submitExtrinsic.
Serialize the sign-and-submit critical section so concurrent proofs cannot read and spend the same runtime nonce.
Keep SVM settlement submission fail-closed until independent transaction-inclusion and bank-state evidence exists.

verification.command: SKIP_WASM_BUILD=1 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo clippy -p x3-relayer --all-targets -- -D warnings

negative_and_boundary_tests: A zero runtime intent is refused before signer lookup or network access.
A missing local runtime signer is named explicitly.
An unconfigured X3 EVM domain cannot silently default to Ethereum.
The runtime signer account must match the configured relayer account.
Portable proof conversion rejects malformed payloads, mismatched headers, wrong roots, invalid receipt indexes, and event-field mismatches.
The HTTP submission test verifies the JSON-RPC method and returned transaction hash.
limitations: No live Sepolia or Ethereum mainnet extrinsic was submitted.
Custody-service signing still requires a separate custody bridge; only a local sr25519 runtime signer is implemented.
The standalone x3-relayer binary still uses its legacy monolithic service and has not been replaced by RelayerService.
SVM settlement remains refused pending independent transaction-inclusion and bank-state evidence.
